scripted: strategy approved as written (reply not scripted; most conservative option): one idea 'a small friend who reads with you'; mascot inside a combination lockup; avoid blue, rainbows, big-eyed animal guides (bear, elephant, owl, birds), open books; own a warm coral or marigold and a few-shape non-animal character. scripted: first reaction 'the character turns into a blob at the avatar size'. Probing question: what reads wrong, at what size, in which mockup? Answer: 'at the avatar size'.
